title: task-board: regression lock for the 64KiB body-cap (413) + traversal spec + stale mode.md line
description: Follow-up from the TASK-074 review (2026-07-02). MEDIUM: the 413 body-cap guard on the board POST routes is present in source but lost ALL regression coverage - every 413 assertion lived in the deleted console specs (chat-routes, mode-badge-routes, preview-routes shared the same readBody helper); a future edit dropping the cap would ship green. LOW riders: the path-traversal guard on POST /api/tasks/:key/status has never had a direct spec; commands/mode.md line ~24 still references the deleted GET /api/session route and session-projection.
acceptance_criteria: One spec: POST /api/tasks (or /api/tasks/:key/status) with a body over 64KiB returns 413; red-green proven against the guard.
One spec: POST /api/tasks/..%2f..%2fetc/status (traversal-shaped key) returns 404 via the KEY_RE guard.
commands/mode.md no longer references GET /api/session or the bounded projection; mode remains documented via the session bundle field.
